guideText:
[accent]=== WELCOME TO QOL CONTROL ===[]
This mod integrates advanced gameplay utilities, automated mining, keybind managers, and processor enhancements.

[accent]=== MODULE SETTINGS ===[]
Go to [accent]Settings -> QoL Settings[] to enable/disable specific modules. Each toggle contains a brief description of the module's behavior.

[accent]=== CHAT COMMANDS ===[]
Most features are toggled and configured via chat commands. Command descriptions are available in [accent]Settings -> QoL Settings[] (in each module's description).

[accent]=== FOO'S CLIENT COMPATIBILITY ===[]
If you use [accent]Foo's Client[], make sure to enable the [accent]Foo's Client Compatibility[] option in [accent]Settings -> QoL Settings[]. Also, you must use the command prefix [orange]?[] (e.g., [orange]?aim[] or [orange]?mining[]) to prevent conflicting commands.

[accent]=== COMMAND SYNTAX GUIDE ===[]
When reading command descriptions, please understand the placeholder formatting:
• [orange]<arg>[]: Required parameter. Replace this with an actual name or value. Do NOT type the brackets or the placeholder name itself.
  [lightgray]Example:[] [accent]!grab <item>[] -> type [accent]!grab sand[] (do NOT type [accent]!grab <item>[] or [accent]!grab <sand>[]).
• [orange]<arg?>[]: Optional parameter. It can be omitted completely.
  [lightgray]Example:[] [accent]!grab <item> <amount?>[] -> [accent]!grab sand[] (default amount) or [accent]!grab sand 100[] (specified amount).
• [orange]<1/0>[]: Binary toggle. Use [accent]1[] or [accent]on[] to enable, or [accent]0[] or [accent]off[] to disable.
• [orange]<option1|option2>[]: Choose one of the listed values.
  [lightgray]Example:[] [accent]!render <unit|block|bullet>[] -> type [accent]!render unit 0[].
• [orange]<items...>[]: Specify multiple items separated by spaces.
  [lightgray]Example:[] [accent]!mining mono <items...>[] -> type [accent]!mining mono copper lead sand[].

[accent]=== SUPPORT THE PROJECT ===[]
If you find this mod helpful, please consider leaving a [orange]Star on GitHub[]! It helps make the project more visible and motivates further development.

[accent]=== MORE INFORMATION ===[]
Detailed command lists, advanced logic tools info, and guides are available on our [accent]GitHub repository[]. Short reference sheets are available inside the mod settings menu.
updateText:
[accent]Mod updated to v{version}![]
[lightgray]Previous version: v{previous}[]

[accent]What's New & Changed:[]
• [orange]Keybind crash fixed[]: recording a key in [accent]!bind[] threw "Cannot find function get in object TextButton" and crashed the client. The label update now goes through the button cell as intended.
• [orange]Custom button icon crash fixed[]: picking an icon in [accent]!cbinds[] hit the same crash, and would also have wiped the button label afterwards. The button now repaints its contents correctly.
• [orange]Generator fuel fixed[]: the combustion generator was fed blast-compound and spore-pod along with coal, burning expensive stock. Generators now use a fuel whitelist - combustion takes [accent]coal[] only.
• [orange]RTG generator support[]: [accent]rtg-generator[] was never refuelled because it was not recognised as an item generator. It is now filled with [accent]thorium[] only.
